messages.content: 計算樣本平均值為98.2、標準差為1.4、樣本大小為40的零假設檢定的標準差，以得到人口平均值為98.6。

function.name: statistics_calculate_p_value
function.description: Calculate the p-value for a t-test on a single sample from a population. Note that the provided function is in Python 3 syntax.

sample_mean.description: The mean of the sample data. This is a float type value.

population_mean.description: The mean of the population data. This is a float type value.

sample_std_dev.description: The standard deviation of the sample data. This is a float type value.

sample_size.description: The size of the sample data.

two_tailed.description: Whether the test is two-tailed. If not provided, default is true.

message.reasoning: The user says: "計算樣本平均值為98.2、標準差為1.4、樣本大小為40的零假設檢定的標準差，以得到人口平均值為98.6。" They want to calculate the standard deviation for a null hypothesis test? Actually they give sample mean 98.2, sample std dev 1.4, sample size 40, and population mean 98.6. They want to compute the standard deviation for the null hypothesis test? Maybe they want the standard error? Or the t-statistic? The phrase "零假設檢定的標準差" might refer to the standard error of the mean under null? Usually we compute the standard error: s / sqrt(n). That would be 1.4 / sqrt(40) = 1.4 / 6.3249 = 0.2214. Then compute t-statistic: (98.2 - 98.6) / SE = -0.4 / 0.2214 = -1.806. Then p-value? They didn't ask for p-value but maybe they want the standard deviation of the sampling distribution? That is the standard error. So answer: standard deviation of sampling distribution = 0.221. Provide t-statistic and p-value? They didn't ask for p-value. But maybe they want to compute the p-value. The question: "計算樣本平均值為98.2、標準差為1.4、樣本大小為40的零假設檢定的標準差，以得到人口平均值為98.6。" Means "Calculate the standard deviation for the null hypothesis test with sample mean 98.2, standard deviation 1.4, sample size 40, to get population mean 98.6." Might be ambiguous. I'd interpret as compute the standard error of the mean. So answer: 0.221. Also compute t-statistic: -1.81. Provide p-value: two-tailed ~0.078. Let's compute precisely: SE = 1.4 / sqrt(40) = 1.4 / 6.3249 = 0.2214. t = (98.2 - 98.6)/0.2214 = -0.4/0.2214 = -1.806. df=39. p-value two-tailed: using t distribution. For t=1.806, df=39, p ~ 0.078. So answer.
